tools.name: get_matter_timeline
tools.description: Clio matter overview: detail, custom fields, related contacts including adjusters, latest 5 notes and comms, pending tasks. Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: list_matter_communications
tools.description: Communications logged on a Clio matter (emails, phone calls), newest first. Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: list_matter_documents
tools.description: Documents stored in Clio under a matter, newest first: name, type, size, folder, last updated. Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: download_matter_document
tools.description: Short-lived download link for one Clio document (id from list_matter_documents). Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: list_clio_custom_field_definitions
tools.description: The firm's Clio custom fields (matter or contact): id, name, field type. Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: list_matter_custom_fields
tools.description: Every custom field on a Clio matter with its type and current value, and whether the field is writable as text. Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: list_clio_expense_categories
tools.description: The firm's Clio expense categories. Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: get_matter_trust_balance
tools.description: A Clio matter's trust balance and other account balances. A firm or matter with no trust account gets a plain no-trust answer. Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: create_calendar_event
tools.description: Adds a Clio calendar entry (court date, deadline, meeting), optionally linked to a matter. No attendees or invites. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

tools.name: delete_calendar_event
tools.description: Deletes one Clio calendar entry by its event_id. Refuses repeating entries (that would delete the series). A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

tools.name: create_matter_expense
tools.description: Records a hard-cost Clio expense as the signed-in Clio user, matter attorney, firm default, or sole Clio user. Does not bill anyone. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

tools.name: update_matter_custom_field
tools.description: Writes a text custom field on a Clio matter. Refuses non-text fields; an existing value needs confirm_overwrite: true. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

tools.name: set_matter_stage
tools.description: Moves a Clio matter to another stage of its practice area, by stage name. Nothing else changes. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

tools.name: set_matter_practice_area
tools.description: Changes a Clio matter's practice area by name, with a stage when that area uses stages. Nothing else changes. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

tools.name: set_up_matter_billing
tools.description: Sets up Clio billing on up to 50 matters: open date, Case Value, flat fee, fee entries. Does not create a bill or apply a payment. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

tools.name: issue_bill
tools.description: Issues a DRAFT Clio bill: awaiting payment, due in 30 days. Does not email it or apply a payment. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

tools.name: create_portal_workspace
tools.description: Creates a portal workspace and its auto packets. Same URL for the matter. Does not send email. Sign-in required.

tools.name: preview_add_portal_packet
tools.description: Preview adding a catalog packet. Reports missing operator fields. Does not email or change the URL. Sign-in required.

tools.name: add_portal_packet
tools.description: Adds a catalog packet to an existing workspace. Same URL. Does not send email. Sign-in required.

tools.name: get_matter_workspace
tools.description: Read a workspace and its packet statuses. Sign-in required.

tools.name: find_matter
tools.description: Searches Clio matters by display-number prefix, description, or client name. Digits match display numbers only. Each hit includes related contacts (name, role, company), including adjusters. Read-only. Fictional sample. No sign-in.

tools.name: get_matter
tools.description: One Clio matter: status, dates, practice area, attorney, client, stage, custom fields, and related contacts (name, role, company), including adjusters. Read-only. Fictional sample. No sign-in.

tools.name: list_open_matters
tools.description: Open Clio matters, a page at a time (default 20); pass next_page_token back as page_token. Clio's status is shown as-is; an Open matter with a close date is flagged close_date_set. Read-only. Fictional sample. No sign-in.

tools.name: list_matter_tasks
tools.description: Lists tasks on the matter: name, assignee, due date, and completion. Sign-in required.

tools.name: list_matter_notes
tools.description: Lists activity notes on the matter, newest first. Sign-in required.

tools.name: get_intake_submission
tools.description: Packet statuses for the matter's client portal (which questionnaires and documents are ready, submitted or signed). Statuses only; questionnaire answers are not included. Sign-in required.

tools.name: list_dropbox_folder
tools.description: List files in the matter Dropbox folder. Sign-in required.

tools.name: search_dropbox
tools.description: Searches filenames in the matter Dropbox folder. Sign-in required.

tools.name: read_dropbox_file
tools.description: Read a document in the matter folder or return a short-lived download link. Sign-in required.

tools.name: search_my_email
tools.description: Search the signed-in mailbox. Identity is the OAuth caller; no mailbox override. Sign-in required.

tools.name: get_email_thread
tools.description: Read a mailbox thread. Flags which messages carry attachments. Sign-in required.

tools.name: list_calendar_events
tools.description: Reads the signed-in calendar for a date window. Recurring events are expanded. Does not create or move events. Sign-in required.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: Invoices for one matter: total, balance, paid (balance 0), due date, last payment date. customer_match "confirmed" (manually linked) or "exact" (name match) means these invoices belong to the matter; "none"/"ambiguous" returns no invoices plus unconfirmed possible_customers. Does not create, send, o

tools.name: list_staff_automations
tools.description: Catalog of named workflows. Not a runner. Sign-in required.

tools.name: list_portal_status
tools.description: Client portal progress: who has not started, is part way, or submitted the questionnaire, when the link was emailed and last client activity. States only, not questionnaire answers. Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: resend_portal_link
tools.description: Emails a client their portal invite again, same link, from the firm. Refuses test leads, submitted portals, or a send in the last 24 hours. Does not CC anyone. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

tools.name: list_recent_leads
tools.description: Open leads on the firm's Asana intake board, newest first: stage (board section), matter type, questionnaire status, source, whether email/phone/portal are on file, packet statuses, and whether a matter is open. Does not return email addresses, phone numbers or portal links. Sign-in required.

tools.name: get_lead
tools.description: One lead from the intake board: stage, matter type, questionnaire status, source, UTM source/medium/campaign, landing page and the opened matter id. No email, phone or portal link. Sign-in required.

tools.name: get_questionnaire_submission
tools.description: Questionnaire answers from the client portal, by lead_id or matter_id. format: text gives labelled plain answers. Social Security numbers and dates of birth are withheld. Sign-in required.

tools.name: list_engagement_letters
tools.description: Engagement letters by client: fee, services, whether the client opened or signed it in DocuSeal, invoice paid, and the next step. No signing or payment links. Sign-in required.

tools.name: search_tasks
tools.description: Find Asana tasks by name, within one matter (matter_id) or across the firm's Asana (top 20 matches). Sign-in required.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Read one Asana task: name, notes, assignee, due date, completion, projects and sections, custom fields, subtasks. On a lead task, email, phone and portal links are replaced with placeholders. Sign-in required.

tools.name: link_lead_to_matter
tools.description: Records that a lead belongs to an existing opened matter (Asana project) and its Dropbox folder, on the lead's portal record. Changes nothing in Asana or Dropbox. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

tools.name: create_matter
tools.description: Opens a new matter from a lead: creates the Asana project from the firm's matter template in the portfolio for its Matter Type, creates the Dropbox client folder, records both on the lead, and posts one comment on the lead. Refuses unless the retainer is signed and paid, or staff_override_reason is

tools.name: create_matter_task
tools.description: Adds a task to a matter: a task in an opened matter's project, or a subtask of an intake task. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Changes an Asana task's completion, assignee, due date or name, or appends to its notes (does not replace them). Cannot change custom fields. Refuses on a lead whose portal-link email is pending. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change.

tools.name: create_matter_note
tools.description: Posts a note (Asana comment) on an intake matter or a task. Opened-matter projects cannot accept comments; a comment goes on one of the matter's tasks. Asana notifies followers. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

tools.name: link_qbo_customer
tools.description: Records which QuickBooks customer a matter belongs to, after a person confirms a match (for example from possible_customers on an invoice listing). After linking, invoice listing returns that matter's invoices. Changes nothing in QuickBooks or Asana. A first call returns a preview; a second call wit

tools.name: create_dropbox_folder
tools.description: Creates a folder inside the matter's Dropbox folder. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

tools.name: upload_dropbox_file
tools.description: Downloads a file from a public https link (50 MB max) and saves it inside the matter's Dropbox folder. Does not overwrite. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

tools.name: create_matter_document
tools.description: Typesets markdown as a PDF or DOCX on the firm's letterhead and files it in the matter's Dropbox folder. Does not overwrite. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

tools.name: create_dropbox_file_request
tools.description: Creates a Dropbox upload link that saves into the matter folder, and returns the link. Does not email or text it. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

tools.name: move_dropbox_file
tools.description: Moves or renames a file or folder within the matter's Dropbox folder. Does not overwrite or delete. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

tools.name: find_contact
tools.description: Search Clio contacts by name, email or phone. Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: One Clio contact: emails, phone numbers, addresses, and the matters where they are the client. Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: list_matter_calendar_events
tools.description: Clio calendar entries on a matter, now to 180 days. Recurring occurrences expanded; join links removed. `when` is firm-local; start_at is an ISO 8601 timestamp in UTC. Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: list_grow_leads
tools.description: Clio Grow inbox and intake leads (not Clio Manage matters), newest first: untriaged inbox first, then Grow matters. Filter by since (default 30 days), status (inbox/intake/hired/declined), type or text. Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: get_grow_lead
tools.description: One Clio Grow lead (intake, not a Clio Manage matter): status, type, dates, client and primary contact with phones, emails and address, and its Grow notes. Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: get_grow_inbox_lead
tools.description: One untriaged (or recently accepted/rejected) Clio Grow inbox lead: name, phone, email, source, matter type. Not a Grow matter until staff accept it in Grow. Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: find_grow_contact
tools.description: Searches Clio Grow (intake CRM) contacts by name, phone or email, with each contact's Grow leads. Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: list_calls
tools.description: CallRail call logs, newest first (default 7 days): caller, source, duration, outcome, recording. FirmOps does not place or answer calls. Outcome: answered, voicemail, or missed. Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: get_call
tools.description: One CallRail call log: caller, source, duration, outcome, recording, landing page, campaign, note, recording link, and transcript when present. FirmOps does not place or answer the call. Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: list_text_messages
tools.description: CallRail text-message logs, most recent first, with each conversation's latest messages. conversation_id returns one full thread. FirmOps does not send these texts. Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: get_gmail_attachment
tools.description: One attachment from a message in the signed-in person's firm mailbox, by message_id and part_id, as base64 (5 MB max). PDF and images unless allow_any_type. Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: search_shared_mailbox
tools.description: Searches the firm's configured shared mailbox with Gmail syntax. Returns mailbox messages. The address comes from firm configuration. Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: get_shared_mailbox_thread
tools.description: Reads a thread from the firm's configured shared mailbox, oldest first: headers, body (long bodies trimmed), links from HTML (http/https/mailto), and attachments with part_id. Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: get_shared_mailbox_attachment
tools.description: One attachment from a message in the firm's configured shared mailbox, by message_id and part_id, as base64 (5 MB max). PDF and images unless allow_any_type. Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: draft_shared_mailbox_email
tools.description: Saves a Gmail draft in the firm's shared mailbox. Optional attachments (PDF/images), thread_id, or draft_id to add files. Does not send. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

tools.name: send_shared_mailbox_email
tools.description: Sends from the firm's configured shared mailbox. Optional attachments (PDF/images) or draft_id. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

tools.name: search_my_drive
tools.description: Searches the signed-in person's Google Drive, including files shared with them. Returns file ids, names, types, modified times and owners — not contents. Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: read_drive_file
tools.description: Reads a file the signed-in person can open in Google Drive (theirs or shared with them) by file_id. Docs/Sheets/Slides export as text; PDF and images as base64 (5 MB max). Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: draft_matter_email
tools.description: Saves a Gmail draft in the signed-in person's mailbox for a Clio matter, CCing the Clio maildrop so it files when sent. Does not send. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

tools.name: reply_to_matter_email
tools.description: Saves a Gmail draft reply in the same thread in the signed-in person's mailbox, CCing the Clio maildrop. Does not send. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

tools.name: list_matter_bills
tools.description: Bills on a Clio matter, newest first: number, state, issued and due dates, total, balance owing. Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: get_bill
tools.description: One Clio bill: state, dates, billing period, subtotal, tax, total, paid, balance owing, client and matters. Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: list_outstanding_balances
tools.description: Clients who owe the firm money, from Clio's outstanding balances: balance, pending payments, last payment, newest bill due date. Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: list_payments
tools.description: Clio payments in a date window: online (Clio Payments) with state, incl. failed and not yet linked to a client, and payments recorded on bills, incl. plan charges. needs_attention flags them. Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: create_intake_link
tools.description: Creates a client intake link (fee agreement with fees prefilled, then retainer) and texts it from the firm's intake number. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

tools.name: resend_intake_link
tools.description: Texts a client a fresh sign-in link to their existing intake link (same agreement and fees). A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

tools.name: list_intake_links
tools.description: Intake links, newest first: client, offense, county, retainer and status (created, sent, opened, signed, paid, matter_created). Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: cancel_intake_link
tools.description: Cancels an unpaid intake link: expires its Clio payment link and ends the client's sign-in (an unsigned agreement is withdrawn). A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

tools.name: list_ticket_links
tools.description: Traffic ticket links clients started online, newest first: state (quote, needs_staff, accepted...), court, fees, why it needs a person. Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: quote_ticket
tools.description: Sets the price for a traffic ticket (court + fee per citation) and texts the client a link to sign and pay. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

tools.name: decline_ticket
tools.description: Closes a traffic ticket link the firm will not take online. The client sees "please call our office". No text is sent. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

tools.name: search_outlook_email
tools.description: Searches the signed-in person's Outlook mailbox. Words, a name or an address; empty query returns the latest inbox mail. Returns sender, subject, date, preview and ids. Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: get_outlook_thread
tools.description: Reads one Outlook conversation from the signed-in person's mailbox, oldest first: sender, recipients, date, body (long bodies trimmed) and attachments with attachment_id. Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: get_outlook_attachment
tools.description: One attachment from a message in the signed-in person's Outlook mailbox (message_id + attachment_id), as base64, 5 MB max. PDF and images unless allow_any_type. Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: list_outlook_events
tools.description: The signed-in person's Outlook calendar between two dates (default: the next 7 days), recurring events expanded. Times in time_zone (IANA, default UTC). Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: find_outlook_free_time
tools.description: Open slots of at least duration_minutes in the signed-in person's Outlook calendar on weekdays between day_start and day_end, in time_zone. Busy = anything not marked free. Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: search_onedrive
tools.description: Searches file names and contents in the signed-in person's OneDrive. Returns name, folder, size, modified date and item_id. Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: read_onedrive_file
tools.description: Reads one file from the signed-in person's OneDrive by item_id: text of Word, PDF and plain-text files (trimmed), plus a short-lived download link for anything. Read-only. Sign-in required.

tools.name: draft_outlook_email
tools.description: Saves a new email as a draft in the signed-in person's Outlook Drafts folder. Does not send the message. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

tools.name: draft_outlook_reply
tools.description: Saves a draft reply to a message in the signed-in person's Outlook mailbox, in the same conversation. Does not send the message. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_matter_communications, search_my_email, get_email_thread, list_recent_leads, get_lead, get_task, find_contact, get_contact, list_grow_leads, get_grow_lead, get_grow_inbox_lead, find_grow_contact, get_call, list_text_messages, get_gmail_attachment, search_shared_mailbox, get_shared_mailbox_thread, get_shared_mailbox_attachment, list_ticket_links, search_outlook_email, get_outlook_thread, get_outlook_attachment · Private data: get_matter_timeline, list_matter_documents, download_matter_document, list_clio_custom_field_definitions, create_matter_expense, find_matter, get_matter, get_intake_submission, list_dropbox_folder, read_dropbox_file, list_recent_leads, link_lead_to_matter, create_matter, link_qbo_customer, upload_dropbox_file, create_matter_document, create_dropbox_file_request, move_dropbox_file, find_contact, get_contact, get_grow_lead, find_grow_contact, draft_shared_mailbox_email, search_my_drive, read_drive_file, draft_matter_email, search_onedrive, read_onedrive_file · Public sink: issue_bill, create_portal_workspace, preview_add_portal_packet, add_portal_packet, search_my_email, get_email_thread, list_invoices, resend_portal_link, list_recent_leads, get_lead, get_task, create_matter, update_task, upload_dropbox_file, create_dropbox_file_request, find_contact, get_grow_inbox_lead, find_grow_contact, list_text_messages, draft_shared_mailbox_email, send_shared_mailbox_email, draft_matter_email, reply_to_matter_email, search_outlook_email, draft_outlook_email, draft_outlook_reply · Destructive: delete_calendar_event, get_questionnaire_submission, create_matter, upload_dropbox_file, create_matter_document, move_dropbox_file.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
